# Requirements

## REQ-001 Seller lists item

functional, must

The system shall allow a seller to list an item with a starting price, an end time and an item currency chosen from CHF, EUR or USD.

Acceptance criteria:

- A seller can submit an item with a starting price, an end time and a currency (CHF, EUR or USD) and it then appears as an open auction.
- A listing without a starting price, end time or currency is rejected with an error message.
- A listing with a currency other than CHF, EUR or USD is rejected.

## REQ-002 Place bid

functional, must

The system shall accept a bid on an open auction item only if the bidder is not the item's seller and the bid meets the minimum bid rule, with bids entered and stored in the item currency.

Acceptance criteria:

- A bid on an item whose end time has not passed, from a user other than the seller, is stored in the item currency if it is valid.
- A bid on an item whose end time has passed is rejected.
- The first bid is accepted only if it is at least the starting price.
- Any later bid is accepted only if it is at least 1 unit of the item currency higher than the current highest bid, otherwise it is rejected.
- A bid by the item's seller on their own item is rejected.

## REQ-003 Live bid updates

functional, must

The system shall push each new bid to all clients currently watching that item without the client reloading the page.

Acceptance criteria:

- When a bid is accepted, every client watching the item shows the new bid without a page reload.
- A client watching a different item does not receive that bid.
- When a bid or close event arrives, the list of open items refreshes without a page reload.
- If loading the live update configuration fails, the page retries and live updates start once it succeeds.

## REQ-004 Auction close and winner

functional, must

The system shall close an auction when its (possibly extended) end time is reached, declare the highest bidder the winner, and mark the item as unsold if it has no bids.

Acceptance criteria:

- At the end time the item no longer accepts bids.
- The bidder with the highest bid at the end time is recorded as the winner and the winning user sees on the item page that they won.
- Watchers of the item see the closed state and the winner.
- An auction that ends with no bids is shown as unsold and has no winner.

## REQ-005 Prices in bidder currency

functional, must

The system shall display prices to a bidder in the bidder's chosen display currency (CHF, EUR or USD) in addition to the item currency, converted using exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.app), while bids and stored prices stay in the item currency.

Acceptance criteria:

- A bidder who selects CHF, EUR or USD sees item prices and bids converted with a rate obtained from Frankfurter.
- Only CHF, EUR and USD are offered as display currencies.
- Converted prices are shown with the currency code.
- Conversion is for display only: stored bids and bid validation use the item currency.

## REQ-006 Separate services

non-functional, must

The system shall be built as separately deployable services, including at least an API server and a separate live update server.

Acceptance criteria:

- The API server and the live update server run as separate processes or deployments.
- Either service can be started, stopped and deployed without redeploying the other.

## REQ-007 Horizontal scalability

non-functional, should

The system shall allow the API server and the live update server to be scaled independently by running multiple instances.

Acceptance criteria:

- With two or more live update server instances running, a client connected to any instance receives every bid for the item it watches.
- Adding an instance requires no code change.

## REQ-008 Display-name identity

functional, must

The system shall identify users by a unique display name of 2 to 20 characters, without a password, rejecting a name that is already taken, keeping one server-side user id per name and storing the issued user id in the browser, with any user able to act as both seller and bidder.

Acceptance criteria:

- A user can enter a display name of 2 to 20 characters and use the system without a password.
- A display name shorter than 2 or longer than 20 characters is rejected.
- A display name already taken is rejected and the user must pick another.
- The server assigns and stores one user id per display name and the browser keeps the user id it received, so the user is recognised on later visits.
- The same user can list items and place bids on other users' items.
- The system has no admin role.
- Leading and trailing spaces are removed from a display name before the length and uniqueness checks, so 'Bob ' is the same name as 'Bob'.

## REQ-009 Late bid extension

functional, must

The system shall extend an auction's end time by 2 minutes when a valid bid is accepted within the last 2 minutes before the end time.

Acceptance criteria:

- A valid bid placed less than or exactly 2 minutes before the end time moves the end time 2 minutes later.
- A valid bid placed more than 2 minutes before the end time does not change the end time.
- Watchers see the new end time without reloading.

## REQ-010 Exchange rate caching and fallback

functional, must

The system shall cache exchange rates for 1 hour and, when the exchange rate API is unavailable and no valid cached rate exists, show prices only in the item currency.

Acceptance criteria:

- Within 1 hour of a successful fetch, no further request is made to Frankfurter for the same rates.
- After the cache is older than 1 hour, the next conversion fetches fresh rates.
- When Frankfurter cannot be reached and no valid cached rate exists, prices are shown only in the item currency and bidding still works.

## REQ-011 Demo scale and live latency

non-functional, should

The system shall support up to 200 concurrent watchers per item and a few bids per second, delivering each accepted bid to watchers within 1 second.

Acceptance criteria:

- With 200 clients watching one item and a few bids per second, each accepted bid appears on every client within 1 second.
- No accepted bid is lost under this load.

## Out of scope

- Payment processing
- Notifications to winners or other users (the winner only sees the result on the item page)
- Passwords, accounts with login and an admin role
- Scale beyond demo level (more than 200 watchers per item or more than a few bids per second)
- Display currencies other than CHF, EUR and USD
